This Record Producer allows employees to raise their issues through the Service Catalog.
Employees can provide details such as requester name, category, subcategory, and state.
They can also enter a short description of the issue.
The submitted information will create a record in the Employee Raise Issue table.

} 100% { transform: translateY(0); } } /* Paragraph styling */ .commercial-widget p { color: #222; font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 18px; } /* List styling */ .commercial-widget ul { padding-left: 0; list-style: none;
